LanguageData.RPD_Settings_EnableAutoGenTip: Auto-Gen creates personas for new pawns when they join your colony. Configure categories and presets in the config window.
LanguageData.RPD_Settings_ConfigAutoGenTip: Open the Auto-Gen configuration window to set up categories, presets, and context settings.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoGen_EnableTip: Allow Auto-Gen for pawns in this category on first appearance or an eligible role change. This switch does not control Auto-Evolve.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoGen_OnlyOnRoleChangeTip: When a map pawn enters this role, attempt Auto-Gen or Auto-Evolve. Auto-Gen also requires its master and category switches; Auto-Evolve uses its own master and pawn switches. All role triggers are off by default.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoGen_SyncModSettingsTip: Use global ModSettings context instead of custom context for this category
LanguageData.RPD_AutoGen_EditContextTip: Turn off Sync first, then choose which pawn data this category sends to Auto-Gen.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoGen_AdvancedPresetTooltip: Use a RimTalk advanced preset for this category. No pawn data, event, or JSON instruction is added automatically; reference variables and request persona JSON in the preset. "None" uses the built-in prompt.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoGen_InsertTemplateTip: Click to insert a conditional template. Choose from colonist, prisoner, slave, faction, or race templates.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoGen_NotesHint: Built-in mode adds these notes only when Director Notes is enabled. Advanced presets are written entirely by the user in RimTalk.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoEvolve_NotesHint: Built-in mode uses these notes automatically. Advanced presets must explicitly reference evolve_director_notes. Scriban syntax is supported.
LanguageData.RPD_Batch_SceneNotesHint: These notes will be included in generation prompts. Supports Scriban syntax for dynamic content. Use {%raw%}...{%endraw%} to escape code examples.
